messages:
Alex Chen: putting a proposal here — compact left nav that groups models, deployments, and resources under a single 'Workloads' node. main idea: reduce vertical scanning and expose contextual breadcrumbs.
Maya Patel: sgtm, maybe show counts? e.g., Workloads (3)
Samir Gupta: I'd worry about discoverability. People expect 'Models' at top-level. Can we keep top-level quicklinks and collapse the rest?
Eliza Ford: +1 to quicklinks. What if we default to compact view but allow 'expanded mode' via query param ?expanded=1
Alex Chen: yeah — implementation idea: /workspaces/:id?nav=compact or /workspaces/:id#expand. Would prefer query param to preserve deep-link semantics.
Samir Gupta: query param safer for analytics, but fragments support client-side only. Example routes:
```
/workspaces/42?nav=compact
/workspaces/42/models/7
/workspaces/42/deployments?focus=logs
```
Maya Patel: Design nit: breadcrumbs should represent stable pages, not ephemeral panel states. So avoid plumbing KV cache state into URL.
Eliza Ford: Accessibility: when nav collapses, keyboard focus needs clear skip link. Suggest adding an offscreen 'Skip to main' and `aria-expanded` on groups.
Alex Chen: agree. Proposed label copy: 'Workloads' -> 'Workloads & pipelines'? shorter alt: 'Compute'
Nora (design): lean toward 'Workloads' — less jargon. Also we should run a small tree test to validate mental models.
nav-bot: deploy-preview available at https://staging.console.redwood.ai/nav-proto (preview build 278).
Samir Gupta: engineering note: routing change will need legacy redirects for old permalinks. plan: router middleware maps old /models/123 -> /workspaces/42/models/123
Alex Chen: can someone draft a migration plan? @Samir you'll own router shim? :pray:
Samir Gupta: yep i'll take the shim. Will add automated redirects and a feature flag for rollout.
Maya Patel: one more copy tweak — breadcrumb separator uses chevron '›' not slash. small but consistent.
Eliza Ford: leaving a tiny a11y checklist:
- focus trap when nav is open on mobile
- aria-current on active crumb
- visible focus ring for collapsed groups
- announcements for expand/collapse

Alex Chen: thanks all. I'll update the proto and post screenshots in #design later. :sparkles:
